extracted.intended_audience: new and prospective Wattpad writers/creators preparing to publish their first story
extracted.subtask_description: Practical, platform-specific guidance for creating and publishing a first story on Wattpad, including formatting, metadata, media, and discoverability tips. Aimed at helping beginners make their story readable and findable on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create in parts or publish in full
rubrics_metrics.description: You can choose to create your story in parts or in full, and with as much or as little detail as you'd like.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many writers like to publish their stories in parts, as this allows them to gain great feedback from readers along the way.

rubrics_metrics.name: Email verification required to publish
rubrics_metrics.description: You will be able to publish stories once your email address has been verified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify your email before attempting to publish; publishing is disabled until verification is complete.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comply with Wattpad Content Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: While creating your story, please ensure that it meets our Content Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the platform's content rules (linked on the site) to avoid removals or moderation actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: No uploading of text files
rubrics_metrics.description: It isn't possible to upload text files, like PDFs or Word Documents, onto Wattpad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write or paste content directly into Wattpad's editor; plan to maintain an external backup of your text since uploads of files are not supported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Back up your writing off Wattpad
rubrics_metrics.description: Always back up your writing off Wattpad so you have your own version of your story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain local or cloud copies outside Wattpad to prevent data loss or retain versions independent of the platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting options in the editor
rubrics_metrics.description: On the writing page, you can bold, italicize, and underline your text, as well as adjust it to the right, left, or center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You cannot switch between fonts when writing your story, but readers can view text in their preferred font via their reading settings. Use available styles and alignment to personalize appearance while keeping readability in mind.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title
rubrics_metrics.description: Story details include a Title field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose a clear, attention-getting title as part of story metadata that helps attract readers and conveys tone/genre.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description (hook) improves reads
rubrics_metrics.description: Description: Stories with descriptions get 100x more reads than one without! Write a short description that will excite your readers and hook them in.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise, compelling blurb that highlights stakes, tone, or central conflict to boost discoverability and click-throughs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category / genre classification
rubrics_metrics.description: Category: Helps us understand more about your story and classify it by genre.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the most appropriate genre/category so Wattpad can surface your story to relevant readers and in genre-specific feeds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tags (recommend 10+ for discoverability)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adding 10 or more tags can help increase discoverability. Tags should be a word or concept, reflective of your story's themes and subgenres.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use descriptive, theme- and subgenre-focused tags (single words or concepts). The site recommends many tags (10+) to broaden search visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Language: Fill in which language your story is written in to make sure it reaches the right readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accurately indicate the story language so it appears to readers searching/filtering by language and reaches appropriate audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright / repost and remix settings
rubrics_metrics.description: Copyright: Let others know if this story is just yours, or if anyone can repost or remix it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify rights clearly to protect your work or permit sharing/remixing according to your preference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate content rating
rubrics_metrics.description: Rating: Rate your story appropriately to ensure a positive reading experience for your readers with no unwanted surprises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the correct maturity/age rating so readers understand content levels and so the story appears in appropriate filtered results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Story features / metadata fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Story features can help both readers and Wattpad better understand your story. They include Story Notes, time setting, target audience, main characters, dedication, and external links.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use story features to add context and metadata; note that these features are currently only available on the Wattpad website (not all platforms).

rubrics_metrics.name: Add a cover and multimedia
rubrics_metrics.description: Adding a cover to your story helps to personalize it and encourage users to read it. Wattpad also allows you to add pictures and videos to your stories to help bring them to life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create an appealing cover (see Covers 101). You can add header media (appears above the text) and inline media (appears within the text) to enhance engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mark story as Complete
rubrics_metrics.description: When you've finished writing a story, you can mark it as "Complete" to let others know that your story has ended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marking complete can help reach a wider audience because some users prefer finished stories; stories can be filtered by a 'Completed' status in search, improving discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Story details are editable after publishing
rubrics_metrics.description: You can change and modify [story details] at any point.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Metadata and settings are flexible—update descriptions, tags, category, etc., as needed to improve discoverability or correct information.
